correctness.rationale: Every alternating bivector over any characteristic admits normal form ω=Σ_{i=1}^r a_i∧b_i with coefficient rank 2r. The exterior basis decomposes by singly occupied pairs into invariant Boolean-subset modules, on which multiplication by ω is the incidence up-map U_(c,j) from j-subsets to (j+1)-subsets with no signs. Wilson integer diagonal form yields modular ranks b_p(c,j) and hence the complete R_p(n,r) for all n,p. Alternating-form orbit counts give A_q(n,r) and enumerator Σ A_q(n,r)T^{R_p(n,r)}. The Jordan block argument for nilpotent multiplication T_r includes 2^r one-dimensional blocks, implying g_(r+1)>4g_r and strict operator-rank growth at fixed n; in p=2, T_r²=0 implies R2(n,r)=2^(n−r−1)(2^r−1). Independent exhaustive wedge exterior-map linear algebra matches all bivectors in F2 dimensions 2−5 and F3 dimensions 2−4, including H_4,2=1+35T^4+28T^6. Analytic reduction, not finite enumerations, establishes all n and fields.
